one_liner: Google's ad platform; Google Ads API (gRPC/REST) for campaign management and reporting.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user creds or service account. Developer tokens were sunset 2026-09-09; API access level now tied to the Google Cloud project (Test, Explorer, Basic, Standard).
gate_evidence: Enabling the API grants Test access against test accounts; production accounts need Explorer, Basic or Standard access or calls fail with CLOUD_PROJECT_NOT_APPROVED_FOR_PRODUCTION.
blocker: Production access level must be approved per Google Cloud project; multi-tenant needs Basic/Standard access.

evidence.claim: Official Google Ads MCP server (googleads org), read-only by default-config option; OAuth/ADC auth; production needs approved access level; developer tokens sunset 2026-09-09
